question: Will oil stay under $90, yes or no?

lines.text: Brent crude has fallen below ninety dollars a barrel, its lowest since August.
The Guardian says it hit eighty nine dollars sixty six on Tuesday morning.
That came after Donald Trump said the war on Iran is effectively over.
lines.note: Trump, via The Guardian, City AM

lines.text: City AM says Brent is now more than twenty five percent below its late October peak of one hundred and seventeen dollars.
In the strait itself, more gas is moving.
Reuters says thirty one loaded LNG tankers left Hormuz in October, the most since the war began.
That is up from twenty three in September, S&P Global data shows.
Twenty three of October's cargoes were loaded at Ras Laffan in Qatar.
Eight came from Das Island in the UAE.
An S&P analyst says the UAE is back to pre-war levels, and Qatar is above thirty percent.
But Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed on Tuesday that three tankers hit mines and caught fire.
They say the ships used routes Iran has not authorised.
Day two hundred and fifty seven tomorrow. Will oil stay under ninety dollars, yes or no?
